items.source: new instance of the same type
Creates new instance of the same type, using the no-arg constructor.
items.translation: 使用无参构造函数创建同类型的实例。

items.source: All enhanced instances returned by the Enhancer class implement this interface. Using this interface for new instances is faster than going through the Enhancer interface or using reflection. In addition, to intercept methods called during object construction you must use these methods instead of reflection.
items.translation: All enhanced instances returned by the Enhancer class implement this interface。使用此接口创建新实例比通过 Enhancer 接口或使用反射更快。此外，若要拦截对象构造期间调用的方法，您必须使用这些方法而不是反射。

items.source: Return the Callback implementation at the specified index.
items.translation: 返回指定索引处的Callback实现。

items.source: Get the current set of callbacks for ths object.
items.translation: 获取该对象的当前回调集。

items.source:
Creates a new instance of the same type, using the constructor
matching the given signature.
items.translation: 创建使用与给定签名匹配的构造函数的新同类型实例。

items.source: Set the callback for this object for the given type.
items.translation: 为此对象设置给定类型的回调。

items.source: Replace all of the callbacks for this object at once.
items.translation: 一次性替换该对象的所有回调。

items.source:
Creates new instance of the same type, using the no-arg constructor.
The class of this object must have been created using a single Callback type.
If multiple callbacks are required an exception will be thrown.
items.translation: 创建使用无参构造器的同类型新实例。此对象的类必须使用单个 Callback 类型创建。如果需要多个回调，将抛出异常。
